decisions.reason: Net price display remains a basic B2B need with low upkeep, though its absence from the website since 2020 and platform migrations raise some risk of it being retired.
ERP integration is central to multichannel commerce and creates client lock-in, so it is worth maintaining even if it is less visibly marketed.
Price comparison tracking still supports measurable marketing, but declining portal relevance and consent rules make it vulnerable; as the lead variant it is the one most likely to be kept.
A second overlapping tracking plugin that is no longer seen on the website is a likely candidate for consolidation into the main variant during shop-platform migrations.
The third redundant tracking variant offers little added value, and dropping it frees developer capacity for newer platform and multichannel work.
Net price reporting complements the B2B display plugin cheaply, though its lack of website visibility suggests it may be bundled or phased out.
